zh-CN.title: 色不异空，空不异色
zh-CN.subtitle: 《般若波罗蜜多心经》
zh-CN.shortSummary: 这句经文在汉传佛教中传播极广，但需要回到完整段落和具体版本理解。
curatorialDescription: ‘色不异空，空不异色’不是脱离上下文的抽象口号。它出现在对色、空关系的连续论述中，展现般若思想如何通过汉译经典进入中国佛教语境。
zh-CN.researchNote: Alpha 条目已连接文本与版本实体；正式发布前需补充译者、底本、异文和更精确 locator。

quote.original: 色不异空，空不异色。色即是空，空即是色。

interpretation.zh-CN: 可见的形色与空性并非两个彼此隔绝的实体；经文随后继续从受、想、行、识展开说明。
interpretation.en: Form and emptiness are not isolated realities; the passage continues by extending the discussion to feeling, perception, formations and consciousness.

en.title: Form is not different from emptiness
en.subtitle: Heart Sutra
en.shortSummary: This line circulated widely in Chinese Buddhism, but it must be read within its paragraph and textual version.
curatorialDescription: ‘Form is not different from emptiness’ is not a context-free slogan. It belongs to a sustained discussion of the relation between form and emptiness and shows how Prajñāpāramitā thought entered Chinese Buddhist contexts through translated scripture.
